close_reason: Added From<&Certificate> for TrustAnchor; also added note to from_cert() suggesting From when the cert needs to stay alive.
description: TrustAnchor::from_cert(cert: Certificate) takes ownership but only reads two fields (subject, subject_public_key_info). Any caller that also needs the cert after construction must cert.clone() before passing it in, as seen in test one_cert_chain_ok: TrustAnchor::from_cert(cert.clone()). Idiomatic Rust: accept &Certificate, clone only the fields needed. The current signature makes a gratuitous ownership transfer the caller must pay for.
title: TrustAnchor::from_cert takes owned Certificate forcing callers to clone
